discovery_candidate_rule.eligible_candidates: all combinations already frozen by the economic protocol: target x horizon x rolling_window x lead_lag x metric
discovery_candidate_rule.direction: absolute_effect; retain observed sign for validation
discovery_candidate_rule.ranking: largest absolute standardized metric value on discovery
tie_break: negative lead_lag before zero before positive

pass_if_all: candidate metric has same sign as discovery
absolute validation metric >= 0.50 * absolute discovery metric
validation metric is computable on the sealed validation partition
candidate metric has same sign as discovery
absolute holdout metric >= 0.50 * absolute discovery metric
holdout metric is computable on the sealed holdout partition
